summary.plain: The world's deepest underground physics laboratory, built beside a hydropower tunnel under the Jinping mountains in southwest China. Over two kilometres of rock overhead make it an extremely quiet place to search for dark matter.
summary.technical: Underground laboratory complex at the Jinping-II hydropower station traffic tunnel, Sichuan Province, China; CJPL-I (inaugurated 2010) has ~2400 m rock overburden; CJPL-II, a westward extension built by Tsinghua University, adds four large caverns.
